children: shares surged nearly 20% by Friday afternoon trading after a report revealed that advanced chipmakers were considering the use of glass substrates.
The use of glass substrates in processors could increase the amount of high-bandwidth memory in chips, thus increasing processing speeds for AI workloads.
"A lot of players in the Intel

supply chain, you name them, are putting an eye on glass core substrates, in terms of its flatness, its smoothness, in terms of diverse constants like dielectric constants and signal integrity," said SCHMID Chief Sales Officer Roland Rettenmaier during the company's second-quarter 2026
. "So we are engaged with most of or the major of the supply chain players, and we are supporting them with our technology and equipment to make glass core substrates real."

The German-based SCHMID specializes in high-tech manufacturing for electronics, photovoltaics, glass and energy systems. It has also been developing glass substrate solutions. Unlike other substrates, glass substrates are said to provide thinner and smoother packaging material, which can increase chip speeds and reduce power consumption. It also increases the amount of HBM that could be layered on a single chip.
